gates.name: comparators_and_cost

gates.name: evaluation

claim_tiers.conditional_worked_case: Actual real-data computation given explicit, traceable input assumptions; does not validate all scientific assumptions or claim calibrated real coverage.
claim_tiers.calibrated_real_case: Additionally requires compatible independent reference labels/scores and an appropriate joint coverage argument; trial counts alone are insufficient.

exposure_policy: Existing visible results stay retrospective/exploratory. Sealing again or passing a target-flip test does not erase prior exposure.
execution_sequence: freeze applicable task inputs, interfaces and protocol
announce smoke runtime and execute smoke
independently audit smoke and announce revised full estimate
execute full if scientific gates pass
